headline.en: Venezia have a verbal deal for Toni Fernandez
headline.es: El Venezia tiene un acuerdo verbal por Toni Fernandez

summary.en: Venezia have agreed in principle to sign Toni Fernandez for about four million euros. Fabrizio Romano said the deal includes 50 percent of a future sale and a buy-back. Fernandez is 18 and in the last year of his contract. Hector Fort and Alvaro Cortes left in the same way.
summary.es: El Venezia pacta a Fernandez cerca de cuatro millones. Romano cita un 50 por ciento de futura venta y una recompra. Tiene 18 anos.

body.en: Toni Fernandez is close to joining Venezia. The verbal agreement is about four million euros. Fabrizio Romano said Barcelona want 50 percent of a later sale and a buy-back. MARCA put the fee closer to five million. The contract is not lodged yet, so the exact number can still move. Fernandez is 18. He has played a few first-team minutes but is behind Yamal, Raphinha, Gordon and Adeyemi. Venezia would give him regular games. Hector Fort and Alvaro Cortes were sold on similar terms. The income helps Barcelona stay inside the 1:1 salary rule. It does not pay for Rodri or Gordon. Xavi Espart was promoted to the first team in the same week. The club is keeping the players Flick wants and selling the ones who will not play.

headline.en: Raphinha is leading the press without a centre-forward
headline.es: Raphinha dirige la presion sin un delantero centro

summary.en: Mundo Deportivo said Barcelona have changed how they start the press without a classic centre-forward. Against Elche and Athletic, Raphinha set the height of the line. Rayo defend deep. Monday will show if that shape still works.
summary.es: Mundo Deportivo dijo que Raphinha marca la altura de la presion. El Rayo se cierra. El lunes se vera si funciona.

body.en: Barcelona have started the Liga season without a classic number nine. Mundo Deportivo said Raphinha now sets the height of the press. Against Elche and Athletic he came inside as well as staying wide. Fermin and Pedri joined him from midfield. Athletic left space and Barcelona scored twice. Rayo usually sit deeper. If they pack the box, Barcelona will have less room for those runs. Flick can start Ferran Torres as a closer reference. He has not done that in the first two Liga games. Julian Alvarez is still at Atletico. That file is separate. The choice for Monday is whether Gordon or Adeyemi starts on the left to help the first wave, and whether Pedri covers Gavi again.

headline.en: Xavi Espart is a first-team player and will wear number 12
headline.es: Xavi Espart es del primer equipo y llevara el 12

summary.en: Barcelona have registered Xavi Espart with LaLiga and given him shirt number 12. He is 19. Flick started him at left-back against Elche and used him higher up against Athletic. Cadena SER said a Masia player has forced his way into the squad again.
summary.es: El Barca ha inscrito a Espart con el dorsal 12. Tiene 19 anos. Fue titular en Elche y jugo por dentro ante el Athletic.

body.en: Xavi Espart is now on the first-team list. He wore 36 against Elche and will wear 12 once the change is complete. He is 19 and can play both full-back roles and as a midfielder. Flick compared him to Philipp Lahm last year and started him at left-back in Elche. Against Athletic he also moved inside. Cadena SER reported the promotion on Friday. Hector Fort left. Espart stayed. Alejandro Balde is back in the squad but has not started. Joao Cancelo is now registered too. Promotion puts Espart on the list. It does not lock him into the eleven for Rayo. It does mean Flick can name him without calling him up from the B team.
